claim.quote: The results of the measurement of the $e^+e^- \to n \bar{n}$ cross section and effective neutron timelike form factor are presented.

date.locator: arXiv abstract page, submission date (arXiv:2309.05241, 11 September 2023)

key_value_text.quote: The measured cross section is 0.4-0.6 nb. The neutron form factor in the energy range under study varies from 0.3 to 0.2.
key_value_text.value: Cross section 0.4-0.6 nb; effective neutron form factor from 0.3 to 0.2 for √s = 1891-2007 MeV

name: Measurement of the neutron timelike electromagnetic form factor with the SND detector
notes: Chosen as a recent SND headline result; SND also published many other exclusive hadron cross sections.

summary.plain: SND measured how often electron-positron collisions at 1.89 to 2.0 GeV make a neutron and an antineutron, from data taken in 2020 and 2021 at VEPP-2000. The neutrons were detected by their time of flight in the non-magnetic detector.
summary.technical: SND at VEPP-2000: e⁺e⁻ → n n̄ cross section and effective neutron timelike form factor for √s from 1891 to 2007 MeV; data of 2020-2021; neutron-antineutron events selected by time of flight in the nonmagnetic SND; measured cross section 0.4-0.6 nb, neutron form factor from 0.3 to 0.2.

title: Measurement of the neutron timelike electromagnetic form factor with the SND detector
why_it_matters: The abstract reports the cross section and the effective neutron timelike form factor over the energy range studied.
